about.title: The sovereign cloud that adapts to you
about.statement: A local, secure and controlled cloud, serving our clients' performance.
about.text1: Fluidity SA is a sovereign cloud platform in Tunisia, specialized in cloud services, data hosting and IT infrastructure solutions for businesses and organizations. Our services are hosted locally, secured and tailored to performance, availability and data-control requirements.
about.text2: Founded on 18 December 2025, Fluidity builds a sovereign alternative to foreign clouds: your data stays in Tunisia, under Tunisian law, with close-range technical support and solutions personalized to your needs.
about.mission: Provide businesses with reliable, secure cloud and IT services tailored to their needs.
about.vision: Become a reference player for sovereign cloud and digital services in Tunisia.

story.title: Born in Tunisia, for Tunisian businesses
story.text1: Founded on 18 December 2025, Fluidity SA is a sovereign cloud platform whose main activity, declared with the National Business Register, is data processing and hosting. It was born from a simple observation: Tunisian businesses need a local, reliable cloud that meets their own requirements.
story.text2: Our ambition: locally hosted, secured services tailored to performance, availability and data-control requirements — with the close-range support that international clouds cannot offer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how Fluidity SA collects and processes personal data submitted via this site, in accordance with Tunisian law No. 2004-63 on personal data protection and, for its international clients, the GDPR.
privacy.dataText: The contact form collects: name, email, phone, company and message. This data is used solely to answer your request and kept only for the time needed to process it.
privacy.usageText: Your data is never sold, transferred or shared with third parties for commercial purposes. Only authorized Fluidity SA staff have access, and it is hosted on our sovereign infrastructure in Tunisia.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectify, oppose and delete your data. To exercise it, write to us: privacy@fluidity.tn.

values.title: Sovereignty
values.description: Your data stays in Tunisia, hosted on our local infrastructure and governed by Tunisian law: control of your digital sovereignty is not something you delegate.

values.title: Trust
values.description: Security, availability and transparency on our commitments: we build relationships that last, contract after contract.

values.title: Proximity
values.description: A team based in Tunisia, reachable and responsive: close-range technical support, from study to operations.

values.title: Adaptation
values.description: No rigid catalogue: solutions you can tailor to your needs, your constraints and your growth trajectory.

services.title: Cloud Infrastructure / IaaS
services.description: Cloud resources to host your environments and applications: virtual machines, CPU, RAM, storage and network, on demand.
points: CPU, RAM, storage and network resources

services.title: Hosting
services.description: Hosting for your applications, websites and databases on our sovereign infrastructure in Tunisia, with the availability levels your business demands.

services.title: Backup
services.description: Encrypted cloud backup for your critical data: retention strategies, externalized copies and fast, tested restoration.

services.title: Disaster Recovery / DRP
services.description: Disaster recovery planning: replication of your critical systems, controlled failover and guaranteed service continuity in case of a major incident.

services.title: Connectivity
services.description: Dedicated, secure network links between your sites and our cloud: VPN, private interconnection and guaranteed quality of service for your business flows.

services.title: Cybersecurity
services.description: Protection for your systems and data: firewalls, intrusion detection, hardening and compliance support, built into our cloud.

services.title: Monitoring & managed services
services.description: Our teams monitor and operate your infrastructure 24/7: proactive monitoring, maintenance, support and continuous improvement.

services.title: AI Cloud
services.description: GPU resources and AI platforms hosted in Tunisia: train and deploy your models without your data ever leaving the country.

solutions.title: Sovereign private cloud
solutions.problem: Your critical applications run on foreign providers: unpredictable latency, data outside Tunisian law, remote support and costs in foreign currency that spiral.
solutions.solution: We migrate your environments to a private cloud hosted in Tunisia: dedicated resources sized to your real workload, with a local team that knows your systems and intervenes up close.
benefits: Close-range support in French and Arabic

solutions.title: Business continuity
solutions.problem: A major outage, disaster or ransomware can halt your business for days: without a tested recovery plan, every hour of downtime comes at a heavy price.
solutions.solution: We design your continuity framework: encrypted backups, replication of critical systems to our cloud and a regularly tested DRP, for recovery measured in minutes rather than days.

solutions.title: Sovereign data & compliance
solutions.problem: Public sector, healthcare, finance: your obligations require control over data location and protection, while your current tools scatter it across hosts beyond your control.
solutions.solution: We host your sensitive data on our Tunisian infrastructure with encryption, strict access control and complete logging — a foundation aligned with security and localization requirements.
